note: Identity of the NotBefore DECISION LOG as a C2SP transparency log (DECISION-LOG.md, NOTBEFORE.md §7.12). A second origin, distinct from the pulse log (keys/CHECKPOINT.json): it records consumers' signed decision statements, write-once per (key_id, decision_id). The origin line is PERMANENT. The checkpoint key is held by the Worker that serves notbefore.net (secret DECISIONS_SIGNING_KEY) with an offline backup on the minting host; it asserts 'this is the decision log', nothing about any pulse.
signer: Cloudflare Worker 'notbefore' (public/worker/decisions.js), storage D1; source in this repository
mirror: decisions/ in this repository, written by decisions_mirror.py on the minting host (:20 and :50), witness-cosigned there
write_once_rule: the first valid statement for (key_id, decision_id) is the authoritative preregistration (seq_in_namespace 1); later statements for the same tuple are amendments and are never the one `execute` accepts for the original randomization
enabled_note: enabled becomes true in the release that ships after the Worker and its D1 database are live; until then the CLI signs contracts and reports 'decision log not enabled in this release' instead of submitting
